build_knn_cuda: build a CUDA-based KNN module using a heap data structure to find k-nearest points in 3D space
create_knn_forward: create a forward pass that finds k-nearest neighbors for point cloud features with optional center points
test_knn_class: test the KNN class by calling KNN.apply with k, xyz tensor, and optional center_xyz tensor
refactor_knn_transposed: refactor the KNN forward method to handle both transposed and non-transposed tensor input formats
review_knn_backward: review the KNN backward method that returns None for all inputs since KNN is non-differentiable
